gaps: Price per litre or per m2 of Ultra-Ever Dry TOP coat, NeverWet kit or any fluorosilane topcoat: only the 50 gallon bottom-coat distributor price was found (top coat price page returned nothing).
Density or solids of Ultra-Ever Dry (SDS Section 9) was not extracted; areal dry mass in g/m2 for Ultra-Ever Dry, NeverWet, Rain-X not printed by any source found.

NeverWet two-step kit coverage appeared only on a retailer-review aggregator that looked like generated content (10-15 sq ft per kit), so it was not used; outdoor UV life for NeverWet not found in a manufacturer source.

NASA or Boeing superhydrophobic/icephobic coating durability in months or years: NASA Langley/Glenn items were found (Beaudry/Wohl, Kreeger) but no quotable months-of-outdoor-life value was extracted; the Iowa State AIAA paper gives only 60 min of accelerated rain erosion.

Peer-reviewed multi-month outdoor weathering of a superhydrophobic coating with a retained contact-angle value: a Materials 2023 (doi 10.3390/ma16103729) outdoor test was located but exposure duration and retained values were not extracted.
Optical transmittance of a superhydrophobic coating (percent) not found; only the qualitative "hazy translucent white".
Heater film areal mass in g/m2 for etched-foil or carbon heaters other than Minco 0.04 g/cm2 (typical); one other datasheet (Taiwan King Lung, 0.05 g/cm2) could not be fetched and is not recorded.
Dew-prevention heating in W/m2: dew heater strip power was found (25.8 W) but strip width was not printed, so no area power density; no camera/telescope source in W/m2.
Aircraft anti-icing W/m2 from NASA or SAE (Strehlow and Moser 2009) is paywalled or not printed in the extracted text.

Airship or aerostat hangar cost per m2 of floor, and fabric-membrane hangar prices with spans: no quotable $ per m2 from a trustworthy source (cost-guide pages were content-farm copies and were rejected); Lindstrand hangar price not printed.
Aerostat shelter cost data: none found.

Air knife kW per metre: no data sheet printed it; only blower motor kW (Spray) and hp (Fuji) and compressed-air SCFM per inch (EXAIR). Residual water after blow-off in micrometres: not found as a measured value; a patent says only that an air knife can leave film "as close as zero" (not recorded). Car-wash dryer kWh per vehicle not found.

Rain covers: no 2-5 mil polyethylene film or Tyvek-type areal mass from a manufacturer data sheet was verified; 30D silicone nylon at 40-47 g/m2 appeared on retailer pages that returned 410 or blocked content on fetch, so only the 42 gsm Ripstop by the Roll row is recorded.
